subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It is part of learning.”?
options: Sometimes improving the place where work happens helps the person doing the work.
When reused creatively, they let people sit inside the past for a moment.
A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.
A tired brain may sit at a desk, but it cannot work well.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Sometimes improving the place where work happens helps the person doing the work.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When reused creatively, they let people sit inside the past for a moment.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A graph may look clean, but behind it are years of patient work.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「It is part of learning. A tired brain may sit at a desk, but it cannot work well.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
